other_failure_modes.name: Fatal shape mismatch in multiclass predictions
other_failure_modes.description: For multiclass objectives, gradient boosting models output a 2D array of probabilities (one per class). Converting these to discrete class labels requires taking the argmax along the class axis (e.g. np.argmax(y_pred, axis=1)). Using np.round() instead creates a 2D multilabel-indicator array, which causes a ValueError when passed to metric functions expecting 1D arrays or when assigned to a DataFrame column.

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation but completely neglects data cleaning and feature engineering. Crucially, the solution contains a fatal execution error: it attempts to extract multiclass labels from predicted probabilities using `np.round()` instead of `np.argmax()`, which will cause the evaluation metric and submission creation to crash due to a dimensionality mismatch.
